Repository: https://github.com/Open-WP-Club/plugin-hub
== Privacy Policy ==
Plugin Hub contacts GitHub for the published Open WP Club catalog and plugin management. The catalog includes Partner/Champion supporter credits with bounded embedded PNG logos. Displaying credits does not contact advertisers, track impressions or send referral identifiers. Hide/show is stored locally as a user preference. Plugin management records local user IDs in its local activity log. No advertising telemetry is sent to Open WP Club or advertisers.

## Highlights

- Strengthened authorization, webhook stock handling, remote image fetching, archive storage and CSV exports.
- Fixed coupon deletion synchronization and background callbacks in WP-CLI.
- Improved recovery when a remote product ID becomes stale, and made duplicate-SKU conflicts clearer in the dashboards.
- Clarified PHP requirements: PHP 8.3+ for production and PHP 8.5+ for the development test toolchain.

## Upgrade note

Downloadable files now retain their original source URLs, including stores previously configured for API file transfer. Remote stores must be able to access these URLs. Files are no longer automatically copied to the remote Media Library.

## Validation

- 4,415 PHP tests and 164 JavaScript tests passed locally.
- Local integration scenarios passed on PHP 8.3, 8.4 and 8.5, with and without Redis.
- Integration coverage includes remote create/update/delete, scheduler jobs, concurrent stock deliveries, cross-process rate limits, HTTP redirects and upgrade migration.
- Extended Docker/Redis integration scenarios remain local and do not add GitHub Actions jobs.
